hook.line: The closing line of every formal letter invites the reader to get in touch. It is polite, short, and always the same few words.
hook.es: No dude en llamarme si tiene alguna pregunta.
hook.en: Do not hesitate to call me if you (formal) have a question.

rule:
*No dude en* + infinitive is the polite invitation: do not hesitate to.

It is a negative command, so it follows the person: *No dude* (usted), *No duden* (ustedes), *No dudes* (tú).

To close, offer your services: *Estoy a su disposición para…*, *Quedamos a su disposición para…* The thing offered follows *para*.

In English *do not hesitate* is already a fixed phrase, and so is the Spanish. The *no* here is not a refusal, it is an invitation.
smallPrint: Teachers call this a negative command used as a polite offer, a standard close in business letters.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *dude* or *dudes*, then type the whole sentence: No ___ en llamarme. (to a stranger, formal)
yourTurn.why: A stranger is *usted*, so the command is *dude*.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *dude* or *duden*, then type the whole sentence: No ___ en pedirnos ayuda. (to several people)
Type it in Spanish: Do not hesitate to call me if you (formal) have a question.
yourTurn.answer: No dude en llamarme si tiene alguna pregunta.
yourTurn.why: *No dude en* + infinitive, then *si* with the condition.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: Do not hesitate to call me. (to a friend)
Type it in Spanish: I am at your (formal) disposal for any query.
yourTurn.answer: Estoy a su disposición para cualquier consulta.
yourTurn.why: *Estoy a su disposición para* + what you offer.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: We remain at your (formal) disposal to answer your questions.
yourTurn.answer: Quedamos a su disposición para resolver sus dudas.
yourTurn.why: *Quedamos* is the *we* form of the closing line.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it for several people: No dude en llamarme si tiene alguna pregunta.
yourTurn.answer: No duden en llamarme si tienen alguna pregunta.
yourTurn.why: Both verbs move to the *ustedes* form: *duden*, *tienen*.
